title: Event Registration
description: Reserve your place at the conference. Pick your ticket, choose the sessions you want to attend, and tell us how we can make your visit comfortable.

elements.name: email
elements.title: Email address
elements.description: Your ticket and event updates will be sent here.

validators.text: Please enter a valid email address.

elements.name: phone
elements.title: Mobile phone
elements.description: Used only for urgent updates on the event day.

elements.name: referralSource
elements.title: How did you hear about the event?

elements.name: ticketType
elements.title: Ticket type
elements.description: All prices are per person and include lunch and coffee breaks on both conference days.

choices.text: Student — $99 (valid student ID required at check-in)
VIP — $449 (front-row seating, speaker lounge, and recordings)

elements.name: ticketQuantity
elements.title: Number of tickets
elements.description: Register up to 10 people of the same ticket type. We will ask for their names by email.

validators.text: Please enter a number between 1 and 10.

elements.name: sessionTracks
elements.title: Which session tracks are you interested in?
elements.description: This helps us size the rooms. You can still switch tracks on the day.

elements.name: tshirtSize
elements.title: T-shirt size
elements.description: Every in-person attendee receives an event T-shirt.

elements.name: dietaryRequirements
elements.title: Dietary requirements
elements.description: Select all that apply so our caterers can prepare suitable meals.

elements.name: dietaryDetails
elements.title: Please describe your allergy or requirement
elements.description: Include how severe the allergy is so the kitchen can take proper care.

elements.name: accessibilityNeeded
elements.title: Do you need any accessibility accommodations?
elements.description: For example, step-free access, reserved seating, live captions, or a sign language interpreter.

elements.name: ticketsSubtotal
elements.title: Tickets
elements.expression: iif({ticketType} = 'standard', 249, iif({ticketType} = 'student', 99, iif({ticketType} = 'vip', 449, iif({ticketType} = 'virtual', 79, 0)))) * iif({ticketQuantity} notempty, {ticketQuantity}, 1)

elements.name: addOnsTotal
elements.title: Add-ons
elements.expression: (iif({addOns} contains 'workshop-day', 150, 0) + iif({addOns} contains 'dinner', 85, 0) + iif({addOns} contains 'recording-access' and {ticketType} <> 'vip', 49, 0)) * iif({ticketQuantity} notempty, {ticketQuantity}, 1)

elements.name: promoCode
elements.title: Promo code
elements.description: Optional. Discounts are applied on the payment page.

elements.name: termsAgreement
elements.title: Terms
elements.requiredErrorText: You must accept the terms to register.

choices.text: I agree to the event terms and conditions and the cancellation policy.

elements.name: photoConsent
elements.title: May we use photos or video of you taken at the event in our marketing materials?

elements.name: newsletterOptIn
elements.title: Send me news about future events and early-bird offers.

completedHtml:
Thanks, {firstName}! Your registration has been received.

Your order total is {orderTotal}. We will send a confirmation and a secure payment link to {email}. Your tickets are issued once payment is complete.
